# Facts

- [world] [id=fact-1] The Guild's official record of the northern border shows 43 degrees from Sentinel Peak to the northern ford.
- [world] [id=fact-2] Master Therin died in the river after mapping the northern ford; official report: drowning.
- [history] [id=fact-3] The Guild Seal is required to bind survey appointments and dispositions.
- [character] [id=fact-4] Alory Vane is a journeyman surveyor recently arrived from the northern survey.
- [place] [id=fact-5] The Thornwood is the only route out of Guild territory toward Kingsport before the border.
